page_note: OECD《Employment Outlook 2024》第23页正文段落之下有一幅图（Figure 1.3），以40个国家代码为横轴的柱状图叠加两组菱形标记与一行红色三角旗标，配注释、来源及StatLink链接。

heading.title: Unemployment rates remain at historically low levels in many countries
heading.subtitle: Unemployment rate (percentage of labour force), seasonally adjusted data

figures.source_line: Source: OECD (2024), "Unemployment rate" (indicator), https://doi.org/10.1787/52570002-en (accessed on 9 July 2024).

components.evidence: teal bars with green and light-green diamond markers plus red triangles in one panel
the EA20 bar is magenta and the QECD bar orange among otherwise teal bars
red triangle legend "Increased over the last 6 months" flags countries, not a quantity
axis reads "ESP, GRC, COL, CRI, TUR, SWE ... MEX, JPN", plus "EA20", "QECD"
the country codes are set at roughly 45 degrees under the baseline
legend row on a grey band between the subtitle and the plot area
the plot area carries a light grey tint behind the bars
faint vertical rules separate country slots; no horizontal rules over the plot
"%" printed above the top tick "18" on the left axis
"Unemployment rate (percentage of labour force), seasonally adjusted data" heading line; axis shows bare 0-18
"Note: The labour force population includes all those aged 15 or more..." then "Source: OECD (2024)..."
"StatLink" glyph with "https://stat.link/1z75tu" under the note lines
40 country slots times bar plus two diamonds, about 136 drawn marks

new_components.name: flag_marker_constant_height
new_components.evidence: red triangles all sit at about y=17 on the value axis, marking a yes/no condition
new_components.why_it_matters: 这些三角形不是数值点，若按轴读数会得到虚假的17左右；表格必须把它们记为布尔标记而非度量。

new_components.name: sorted_descending_categories
new_components.evidence: bars fall monotonically from ESP (~11.7) to JPN (~2.6) across all 40 codes
new_components.why_it_matters: 排序本身提供了排序约束，可用来校验读数顺序，但也使相邻国家柱高差小于刻度分辨率。

new_components.name: legend_period_overridden_by_note
new_components.evidence: legend says "Latest (May 2024)" but note lists Q1 2024, February, March, April, June 2024 per country
new_components.why_it_matters: 同一系列的时间键因国家而异，定位某一柱的"最新期"需要同时读注释，不能只靠图例标签。

spot_checks.mark: the ESP bar for Latest (May 2024), the tallest bar
the GRC Pre-crisis (December 2019) diamond, highest marker in the figure
the CRI Pre-crisis (December 2019) diamond, the lower of the two CRI markers
the MEX Pre-crisis (December 2019) diamond, sitting above the short MEX bar
the JPN bar for Latest (May 2024), the rightmost and shortest bar
the TUR Pre-crisis (December 2019) diamond, near the 13 level
the CAN bar for Latest (May 2024) (June 2024 per the note)

difficulty_notes: 图上没有任何数值标签，纵轴刻度为0,2,4,...,18，每2个百分点约占24像素，即1个百分点约12像素。对2.6这类小值，5%容差只有±0.13个百分点，约1.6像素，落在柱顶抗锯齿与柱边框宽度之内；对3.5的菱形标记，标记本身直径就有5-6像素，且MEX、CZE、JPN三国柱高差不到0.3个百分点，几乎无法区分。CRI/TUR处两个菱形（约12.3与13.4）相距仅十余像素并部分重叠，系列归属与数值都难以确定。相比之下标签层面只需"国家代码+图例名"两个键，负担明显更轻。

suggestions.what_to_add: 新组件 flag_marker_constant_height（固定高度的旗标系列）
suggestions.where_to_change: 图形规格中的系列定义字段：允许某一系列声明为boolean flag并指定绘制高度，记录层不写数值
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 有/无"非数值旗标系列"时，模型是否把旗标误读为约17的数值点

suggestions.what_to_add: unit_in_axis_or_title 与 axis_title_above_axis 组合：标题行承载单位、轴上只有"%"符号
suggestions.where_to_change: 标题块样式字段：figure_number/title/subtitle/unit 四段拆分，并把单位符号放在最高刻度之上
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 单位仅出现在副标题行 vs 出现在轴标签时，导出表格的表头是否保留单位

suggestions.what_to_add: dense_marks_100plus：40个类别×3系列的排序柱+标记混合图
suggestions.where_to_change: 密度上限条件行：类别数上限从约20提升到40以上，并允许每类别3个marks
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 类别数20 vs 40（每格约12像素宽）时逐mark读数精度的衰减曲线

suggestions.what_to_add: mixed_marks（柱上叠加两组点标记）对应的可达精度评估
suggestions.where_to_change: readable判定：由布尔门改为按mark类型（柱顶 vs 重叠菱形）给出容差
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 柱顶读数 vs 重叠标记读数在5%容差下的通过率对比

suggestions.what_to_add: legend_period_overridden_by_note（注释按类别改写系列时间键）
suggestions.where_to_change: 记录层的note字段与系列键：允许per-category的期别覆盖
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 注释中含按国家不同的"latest month"时，表格行键是否需要额外一列时间
